blocks.content: In real-world projects, you'll often read code from other developers, and others will read yours.
Well-organized code makes it easier to understand, update, and debug—crucial for team-based work.
In this lesson, you'll learn the following CSS practices to keep your code clear and efficient:

items: Use class selectors instead of tag selectors.
Reset browser defaults to ensure consistent styling.

blocks.content: Let's explore these practices one by one.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
